newsitem.title: UK: UK shares stage recovery ahead of U.S. FOMC.
newsitem.headline: UK shares stage recovery ahead of U.S. FOMC.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index of leading shares managed to break its six-day losing streak on Tuesday, adding over one percent despite a growing conviction among economists that U.S. interest rates are set to rise for the first time in two years.
The benchmark index finished 55.9 points higher at 4,270.7, just below the day's best levels. The previous six sessions had taken 209 points off the index.
A strong recovery on Wall Street was behind the rally in UK shares on Tuesday. The Dow surged 100.46 points on Monday and was up another 28 points as London markets closed.
